  "strengths": [
    "The oracle is external: every expected digest is a published FIPS 180-4 value, so neither the testbench nor the design defines correctness, and a self-consistent but wrong implementation cannot pass.",
    "The two-block vector exercises chaining end to end, and the init-high negative case proves the chaining path is genuinely selected rather than incidentally matching.",
    "done is caught on its rising edge with a shadow of the DUT's own strobe, never a reference-model signal, so a stuck or repeated strobe cannot desynchronise the suite.",
    "Stimulus is applied only in the settled region after step(), including the reset windows, so no input is sampled at an extra edge.",
    "The block-capture test actively corrupts block_in every cycle after the start edge, which turns an implicit assumption into a measured property.",

  "summary": "The suite covers all eleven Must requirements and all four Should requirements, and its correctness rests on published vectors rather than on a model written alongside the design, which is the strongest oracle available for a hash core. The interesting sequential behaviours are all measured rather than assumed: repeated starts ignored, back-to-back chaining on the done cycle, one-cycle done, busy held for the whole block, block latched at start, and reset abandoning work in flight. The gaps are breadth — no randomised stimulus and a silent guard on the wait loops — not correctness."
